name: Undertow Ledger
description: Utility bottomwear with a dockside point of view.
lore: The first Undertow pair belonged to a tally clerk who kept recording containers after the port computer went dark. Union Tides found the handwritten ledger stitched into the lining and named the run after the water stain across its final page.

description: Everyday bottomwear built around the cooperative's shared pattern.
lore: Six neighborhood workshops submitted a different hem for the same order. The cooperative kept the argument in its pattern book and called the resulting family Common Ground; every later edition credits all six rooms.

name: Wrong Exit
description: Road-minded bottomwear from the workshop's unfinished race ledger.
lore: A courier wearing the prototype took the wrong exit and arrived at an empty finishing line three hours early. Motor Drip kept the route sketch instead of correcting it, and the model's private nickname became its official name.

name: Dry Berth
description: Quiet utility bottomwear with a salt-worn character.
lore: Dry Berth takes its name from a dock that remained on payroll long after the water withdrew. The last caretaker used the empty basin as a cutting floor, laying out cloth between the old mooring rings.

name: Late Checkout
description: Resort-minded bottomwear for an indefinitely extended stay.
lore: The hotel charged its last guest for one extra night every day for eleven years. Palm Ghost inherited the ledger and turned the unpaid stay into a collection for people who regard departure times as suggestions.

name: Floor Memory
description: Club-culture bottomwear with a worn-in, late-night story.
lore: Mercy Static recorded a dance floor after the club had been stripped of speakers and furniture. The soft scuffing left on that tape gave Floor Memory its name, and the original recording still closes every launch party.

name: Unlisted Address
description: Severe bottomwear filed under an address absent from the map.
lore: An archive clerk ordered these for a delivery to a street that had never been built. The parcel returned with a thank-you note, and 2020 Vision has refused to correct the address ever since.

name: Witness Zero
description: Precise eyewear with the reserve of an erased case file.
lore: The original order sheet lists a witness, an appointment and a lens color; every other field is blacked out. 2020 Vision preserved the blank spaces as the identity of Witness Zero.

name: Poolside Alibi
description: Optical fashion shaped by the hotel's long, empty afternoons.
lore: A pair was found beside the hotel pool with two room keys and a receipt dated the following week. Palm Ghost recreated the mood of that impossible afternoon without attempting to identify either guest.

name: Poolside Alibi / 02
description: Optical fashion shaped by the hotel's long, empty afternoons.
lore: A pair was found beside the hotel pool with two room keys and a receipt dated the following week. Palm Ghost recreated the mood of that impossible afternoon without attempting to identify either guest.

description: Optical fashion shaped by the hotel's long, empty afternoons.
lore: A pair was found beside the hotel pool with two room keys and a receipt dated the following week. Palm Ghost recreated the mood of that impossible afternoon without attempting to identify either guest.

name: Blind Index
description: A precise optical object from the archive's misfiled collection.
lore: The archive once indexed its eyewear by the names of people who had never collected it. Blind Index belonged to a customer recorded only as a punctuation mark, which the house still prints in the margin of its fitting notes.

name: Apex Debtor
description: Racing-inflected eyewear with a long memory.
lore: A mechanic accepted a set of lenses in place of an unpaid engine rebuild. When the debtor later won a race, Motor Drip named the optical line after the corner where the debt was finally settled.

name: False Sunrise
description: After-hours eyewear for the walk out of the listening room.
lore: A basement audience once applauded a sunrise that was only an orange work lamp behind a curtain. Mercy Static made False Sunrise for the people who stayed after the trick was explained.

name: Last Witness
description: Restrained eyewear with a ceremonial presence.
lore: Aftersaint's archive contains a seating plan with every name removed except one. Last Witness was developed for that remaining place, then offered to anyone who prefers to remember a room without appearing in its photographs.

name: Double Exposure
description: Optical fashion from a file containing two incompatible portraits.
lore: Two identification photographs arrived under the same name, taken at the same minute on opposite sides of Wiami. The Office kept both and called the resulting eyewear Double Exposure.

name: Double Exposure / 02
description: Optical fashion from a file containing two incompatible portraits.
lore: Two identification photographs arrived under the same name, taken at the same minute on opposite sides of Wiami. The Office kept both and called the resulting eyewear Double Exposure.

name: Room Service Mirage
description: Hotel-lounge eyewear with a faded tropical mood.
lore: Room Service Mirage began with an order for breakfast at a room the hotel had sealed years earlier. The waiter returned with an empty tray and a generous tip; Palm Ghost declines to embellish the story.

name: Public Secret
description: Everyday eyewear from the cooperative's open pattern archive.
lore: The pattern circulated anonymously until seven repair rooms claimed to have lost the original. Hex Comma credits all seven and leaves a space for an eighth.

name: Off-Record
description: Eyewear with a clean, deliberately unregistered identity.
lore: The first fitting took place during an archive inventory when every appointment was supposed to be suspended. A clerk entered the sale on the back of the closure notice, and Off-Record became the one model excluded from the house's numbered ledgers.

name: Night Marshal
description: A compact optical statement from the pit lane after midnight.
lore: The volunteer who waved the final cars home never appeared in the race photographs. Motor Drip found their eyewear in the timing booth and dedicated the design to the person who stayed until the road was quiet.

name: Signal Mourner
description: Eyewear for the last listeners of a disappearing station.
lore: When a pirate station shut down, its audience held a listening party for the empty frequency. Signal Mourner remembers the people who kept turning up with new batteries and nothing left to hear.

name: Last Ferry
description: Work-rooted footwear named for the final crossing.
lore: A ferry crew kept a spare pair aboard for passengers who arrived without shoes. Union Tides took the name from the last entry in that boat's inventory, where the footwear was listed as belonging to everyone.

name: Kill Switch
description: Road-minded footwear with a workshop origin.
lore: Motor Drip's apprentice placed the prototype beside the emergency switch during every engine test. The habit outlasted the apprentice, and a small rectangle on the workshop floor still marks where the first pair stood.

name: Kill Switch / 02
description: Road-minded footwear with a workshop origin.
lore: Motor Drip's apprentice placed the prototype beside the emergency switch during every engine test. The habit outlasted the apprentice, and a small rectangle on the workshop floor still marks where the first pair stood.

name: Pavement Choir
description: Everyday footwear assembled in the language of shared streets.
lore: Hex Comma asked six couriers to walk the same block at the same hour. Their recordings sounded like a rough chorus, and the cooperative used that name for a shoe family made across all six of its early workshops.

name: Pavement Choir / 02
description: Everyday footwear assembled in the language of shared streets.
lore: Hex Comma asked six couriers to walk the same block at the same hour. Their recordings sounded like a rough chorus, and the cooperative used that name for a shoe family made across all six of its early workshops.

name: Grave Courtesy
description: Ceremonial footwear with a quiet, severe character.
lore: A client insisted that their farewell party should leave no mark on the host's immaculate floor. Aftersaint kept the oddly considerate brief and named the design Grave Courtesy, a house joke delivered entirely straight.

name: Grave Courtesy / 02
description: Ceremonial footwear with a quiet, severe character.
lore: A client insisted that their farewell party should leave no mark on the host's immaculate floor. Aftersaint kept the oddly considerate brief and named the design Grave Courtesy, a house joke delivered entirely straight.

name: Marble Debt
description: Resort footwear carrying a little of the hotel lobby's history.
lore: The hotel's marble supplier was paid with a permanent room instead of money. Palm Ghost named this family after the arrangement and still sets aside a pair whenever the supplier's descendants visit.

name: Marble Debt / 02
description: Resort footwear carrying a little of the hotel lobby's history.
lore: The hotel's marble supplier was paid with a permanent room instead of money. Palm Ghost named this family after the arrangement and still sets aside a pair whenever the supplier's descendants visit.

name: Encore Exit
description: After-hours footwear named for the door behind the stage.
lore: Every performer at the old club signed the wall beside the rear exit with the date they promised to return. The wall survived longer than the venue, and Encore Exit takes its name from the signatures that were crossed out twice.

name: Missing Step
description: Precise footwear with a bureaucratic ghost story.
lore: A stairwell in the Office's building has thirteen numbered steps and no twelfth. The facilities department keeps explaining the discrepancy, but the design team prefers the missing number.

name: Saint of Last Turns Helmet
description: A helmet silhouette with the presence of a private racing relic.
lore: The workshop keeps a helmet on the bench reserved for mechanics who finish someone else's repair after closing. No one may take it home; Saint of Last Turns is the version Motor Drip made for those who asked.

name: Saint of Last Turns Crown
description: A helmet silhouette with the presence of a private racing relic.
lore: The workshop keeps a helmet on the bench reserved for mechanics who finish someone else's repair after closing. No one may take it home; Saint of Last Turns is the version Motor Drip made for those who asked.

name: Harbor Vigil
description: Headwear with the quiet authority of a night watch.
lore: The harbor watch once ordered replacement gear for a shift that payroll insisted did not exist. Union Tides delivered it anyway and named the family after the lights that continued moving along the quay.

name: Harbor Vigil / 02
description: Headwear with the quiet authority of a night watch.
lore: The harbor watch once ordered replacement gear for a shift that payroll insisted did not exist. Union Tides delivered it anyway and named the family after the lights that continued moving along the quay.

name: Empty Throne Helmet
description: Sculptural headwear from the atelier's ceremonial archive.
lore: Aftersaint was commissioned to dress an empty chair at a banquet where the absent guest held every title. The chair was removed before dinner, leaving the headwear as the only object anyone remembered.

name: Choir of One
description: Headwear with an underground broadcast lineage.
lore: The station's smallest room was labeled Choir despite holding a single stool. Every caller recorded there became part of the same anonymous ensemble, and Mercy Static gave its name to this headwear family.

name: Choir of One / 02
description: Headwear with an underground broadcast lineage.
lore: The station's smallest room was labeled Choir despite holding a single stool. Every caller recorded there became part of the same anonymous ensemble, and Mercy Static gave its name to this headwear family.

name: Civic Phantom Shield
description: Headwear drawn from the Office's unassigned uniform archive.
lore: A municipal portrait arrived without a face but with perfectly recorded clothing dimensions. 2020 Vision retained the measurements and filed the commission under Civic Phantom.

name: Civic Phantom Shield / 02
description: Headwear drawn from the Office's unassigned uniform archive.
lore: A municipal portrait arrived without a face but with perfectly recorded clothing dimensions. 2020 Vision retained the measurements and filed the commission under Civic Phantom.

name: Open Verdict
description: Headwear built around the cooperative's unfinished argument.
lore: The workshops could agree on the pattern but not the name. After months of voting, the blank result sheet became the packaging artwork and Open Verdict became the only phrase everyone accepted.

name: Ninth Chicane
description: A racing-minded headwear family named for a disputed corner.
lore: Eight corners were printed on the event map; the riders swore there were nine. Motor Drip kept the correction in pencil and named the headwear after the turn the organizers would never acknowledge.

name: Ninth Chicane / 02
description: A racing-minded headwear family named for a disputed corner.
lore: Eight corners were printed on the event map; the riders swore there were nine. Motor Drip kept the correction in pencil and named the headwear after the turn the organizers would never acknowledge.

name: Concierge Afterlife
description: Headwear with the ceremonial bearing of a hotel that never quite closed.
lore: The concierge continued laying out tomorrow's uniforms after the final guest departed. Palm Ghost found them arranged by room number and made Concierge Afterlife for the staff reunion held in the empty lobby.

name: Concierge Afterlife / 02
description: Headwear with the ceremonial bearing of a hotel that never quite closed.
lore: The concierge continued laying out tomorrow's uniforms after the final guest departed. Palm Ghost found them arranged by room number and made Concierge Afterlife for the staff reunion held in the empty lobby.

name: Storm Register
description: Utility headwear carrying the memory of a dockside weather book.
lore: The harbor weather register contains one night described only as too loud to write. Union Tides named this family after that entry and leaves the date blank in every collection ledger.

name: Storm Register / 02
description: Utility headwear carrying the memory of a dockside weather book.
lore: The harbor weather register contains one night described only as too loud to write. Union Tides named this family after that entry and leaves the date blank in every collection ledger.

name: Dead Channel
description: Headwear from the station's forbidden hour.
lore: The midnight program consisted of a host reading the names of demolished venues over an empty carrier signal. Dead Channel takes its name from the complaints that made it the station's most requested show.

name: Dead Channel / 02
description: Headwear from the station's forbidden hour.
lore: The midnight program consisted of a host reading the names of demolished venues over an empty carrier signal. Dead Channel takes its name from the complaints that made it the station's most requested show.

name: Unperson
description: Headwear from an archive that records the outline and omits the name.
lore: The original fitting card contains detailed measurements and a perfect impression of an official seal. Where the client's name should be, the paper has been carefully cut away.

name: Procession Error
description: Ceremonial headwear for the guest who joined the wrong farewell.
lore: Two processions crossed outside the atelier, and one guest quietly changed direction. Aftersaint named the commission after that mistake and never asked which gathering had been intended.

name: Procession Error / 02
description: Ceremonial headwear for the guest who joined the wrong farewell.
lore: Two processions crossed outside the atelier, and one guest quietly changed direction. Aftersaint named the commission after that mistake and never asked which gathering had been intended.

name: Red Flag Society
description: Headwear from a workshop club with no scheduled meetings.
lore: A group of retired marshals met whenever a race was cancelled, arriving in their old equipment and refusing to discuss the weather. Motor Drip made their informal society the subject of this family.

name: Red Flag Society / 02
description: Headwear from a workshop club with no scheduled meetings.
lore: A group of retired marshals met whenever a race was cancelled, arriving in their old equipment and refusing to discuss the weather. Motor Drip made their informal society the subject of this family.

name: Sixth Author
description: Cooperative headwear with deliberately shared authorship.
lore: Five workshops signed the pattern, but six sets of corrections appeared on the proof. Hex Comma kept the unidentified edits and reserved the final maker's line for whoever eventually claims them.

name: Vacancy Pilot
description: Open-faced headwear from the hotel's forgotten travel desk.
lore: The hotel offered an airport transfer service for a flight that had been cancelled years before. Its waiting driver became a fixture of the lobby, and Vacancy Pilot borrows the dignity of that endless appointment.

name: Borrowed Horizon
description: Road-rooted outerwear carrying the workshop's long-distance stories.
lore: A rider left a jacket as collateral for repairs and returned with a different name each season. Motor Drip kept a new name in the ledger every time, until the accumulated entries became Borrowed Horizon's first edition list.

name: Floodline Archive
description: Utility outerwear cut from the memory of the working waterfront.
lore: After a canal overflow, the cutting room marked the waterline across every surviving pattern. Union Tides kept the marks when work resumed, turning the archive's damage into a record of who had returned to finish the order.

name: Long Goodbye
description: A long outerwear statement with a private ceremonial mood.
lore: A client requested a coat for a departure that was postponed every year. The atelier kept altering the same pattern until the fitting appointments became an annual reunion.

name: Nocturne Concierge
description: After-hours outerwear with a haunted hotel pedigree.
lore: The night concierge collected the unclaimed coats instead of sending them to storage. Palm Ghost found a seating plan for an imaginary dinner in every pocket and made Nocturne Concierge for those absent guests.

description: Statement outerwear from the station's last live transmission.
lore: The host wore the original during a broadcast made entirely of callers describing the city from their windows. When the archive was recovered, every voice was audible except the host's.

description: A sleeveless utility layer with the cooperative's visible construction.
lore: The first run was assembled from six leftover material orders, each just too small to finish alone. The public repair room kept the joining diagram on its wall long after the collection sold out.

name: Administrative Night
description: Severe outerwear for the archive's unofficial hours.
lore: The building's cleaners kept finding freshly completed forms in an office that had been locked for years. 2020 Vision named this collection after the shift no department would admit to staffing.

lore: The building's cleaners kept finding freshly completed forms in an office that had been locked for years. 2020 Vision named this collection after the shift no department would admit to staffing.

name: Second Ignition
description: Outerwear from the workshop's stubborn habit of rebuilding.
lore: A failed engine was rebuilt so often that none of its first components remained. The mechanic kept the original nameplate, and Second Ignition borrows that refusal to call a repaired thing new.

name: Split Sermon
description: Paired ear modules with a pirate-radio lineage.
lore: Two presenters delivered incompatible versions of the same story on separate channels. Listeners argued for weeks over which one was true, so Mercy Static named the paired modules after the disagreement.

name: Lobby Reverie
description: Headphones inspired by the hotel's endlessly repeating lobby music.
lore: One unfinished piano passage played in the lobby for eleven years. Palm Ghost found the missing final page folded inside a maintenance invoice and named these headphones for everyone who had waited to hear it.

name: Static Communion
description: Headphones with the character of an after-hours listening ritual.
lore: The station held a monthly gathering where each guest brought a recording of a place that no longer existed. Static Communion became the name for the evening and, eventually, for the headphones left beside its listening chair.

name: Closed Session
description: Headphones from the Office's private listening archive.
lore: The records office catalogued a meeting by its silences, carefully timing every pause. 2020 Vision kept that peculiar transcript and made Closed Session for its cabinet of unheard conversations.

name: Velvet Omission
description: A face covering with the reserve of a private ceremony.
lore: A portrait sitter asked the atelier to make everything memorable except the face. Aftersaint kept the commission under Velvet Omission and left the portrait's frame in its fitting room without a picture.

name: Mute Witness
description: A mask family named for the station's most compelling silent guest.
lore: A caller stayed on the line for an entire overnight program without saying a word. The host thanked them before signing off, and listeners began requesting the return of Mute Witness.

name: Dredger's Keepsake
description: Utility facewear with a waterfront provenance.
lore: A dredging crew recovered a sealed lunch tin containing a mask and a handwritten apology. Union Tides borrowed the name from the foreman's inventory entry and left the apology out of the public archive.

name: Blank Deposition
description: Facewear from a file whose only statement is an absence.
lore: The deposition folder holds a signed cover sheet and sixty blank pages. 2020 Vision preserved the exact page count in its design notes, regarding the omission as the most precise part of the record.

name: Pit Silence
description: Compact facewear with a place beside the empty timing booth.
lore: After the final event, the pit crew held a dinner where nobody was allowed to discuss engines. Motor Drip named the design after the longest silence anyone at the table could remember.

name: Borrowed Body
description: A full-suit statement from the atelier's ceremonial wardrobe.
lore: A client ordered a complete outfit for a person described only through other people's memories. Every fitting changed the measurements, and the final garment was collected by someone who refused to try it on.

name: Borrowed Body / 02
description: A full-suit statement from the atelier's ceremonial wardrobe.
lore: A client ordered a complete outfit for a person described only through other people's memories. Every fitting changed the measurements, and the final garment was collected by someone who refused to try it on.

name: Exit Velocity
description: A full-suit silhouette with a racing workshop provenance.
lore: A test rider left a complete outfit hanging beside an unsigned resignation. The workshop kept the empty hanger in its group photograph and named the design after the subject of the final test report.

name: Exit Velocity / 02
description: A full-suit silhouette with a racing workshop provenance.
lore: A test rider left a complete outfit hanging beside an unsigned resignation. The workshop kept the empty hanger in its group photograph and named the design after the subject of the final test report.

name: Duplicate Citizen
description: A full-suit design filed under an impossible second identity.
lore: The Office received two identical applications whose fingerprints, signatures and measurements matched. It approved both and recorded Duplicate Citizen as the name of the discrepancy.

name: Duplicate Citizen / 02
description: A full-suit design filed under an impossible second identity.
lore: The Office received two identical applications whose fingerprints, signatures and measurements matched. It approved both and recorded Duplicate Citizen as the name of the discrepancy.

name: Permanent Guest
description: A full-suit expression of the hotel's longest reservation.
lore: The register lists a guest who checked in before the hotel opened and never requested a bill. Palm Ghost keeps the room prepared and releases Permanent Guest whenever the reservation rolls into another year.

name: Permanent Guest / 02
description: A full-suit expression of the hotel's longest reservation.
lore: The register lists a guest who checked in before the hotel opened and never requested a bill. Palm Ghost keeps the room prepared and releases Permanent Guest whenever the reservation rolls into another year.

name: Public Draft
description: A foundational topwear piece with an open-pattern heritage.
lore: The first pattern was pinned to the wall of a neighborhood laundry with an invitation to correct it. The corrections accumulated until the owner framed the paper and hung a fresh copy beside it.

name: Union Hours
description: Work-rooted topwear named for the time between paid shifts.
lore: The cutters made the first run after hours for colleagues who could not afford the contractor's uniforms. Their handwritten time sheet became the first document signed by Union Tides.

name: Basement Anthem
description: Topwear with the history of a recording nobody officially released.
lore: A rehearsal tape circulated without a label until every basement venue claimed to have recorded it. Mercy Static named the garment after the song everybody recognized and nobody could name.

name: Minibar Gospel
description: Resort-minded topwear with an intimate, nocturnal story.
lore: The hotel's night auditor found a handwritten manifesto tucked behind a minibar price list. Palm Ghost kept only its final instruction: leave something worth finding for the next guest.

name: Dock Receipt Belt
description: A utility belt from Union Tides’s dockside collection.
lore: The dock's oldest receipt was stored in a belt pouch rather than the accounts office. Union Tides discovered that it recorded a debt the entire crew had quietly repaid years earlier.

name: Dock Receipt Pouches
description: A pair of detachable utility pouches from Union Tides’s dockside collection.
lore: The dock's oldest receipt was stored in a belt pouch rather than the accounts office. Union Tides discovered that it recorded a debt the entire crew had quietly repaid years earlier.

name: Shared Waist
description: A layered waist accessory from the cooperative's shared wardrobe.
lore: The repair room kept one adjustable work belt for anyone who forgot theirs. Its modifications accumulated into a pattern that Hex Comma credits to every person who ever tightened a strap.

name: Shared Waist / 02
description: A layered waist accessory from the cooperative's shared wardrobe.
lore: The repair room kept one adjustable work belt for anyone who forgot theirs. Its modifications accumulated into a pattern that Hex Comma credits to every person who ever tightened a strap.

name: Shoulder Season
description: Paired sleeves and shoulder pieces with a pit-lane origin.
lore: The prototype arrived at the workshop in a box labeled winter, during the hottest week anyone could remember. Motor Drip kept the mistaken shipping label and made Shoulder Season a collection without a calendar.

name: Front Row Ghost Gloves
description: A pair of close-fitting gloves from Mercy Static’s Front Row Ghost collection.
lore: One seat in the studio was reserved at every live recording, but the booking card carried no name. Front Row Ghost is dedicated to the pair of gloves found there after the final session.

name: Front Row Ghost Chestpiece
description: A sculpted chest piece from Mercy Static’s Front Row Ghost collection.
lore: One seat in the studio was reserved at every live recording, but the booking card carried no name. Front Row Ghost is dedicated to the pair of gloves found there after the final session.

name: Front Row Ghost Cape

lore: One seat in the studio was reserved at every live recording, but the booking card carried no name. Front Row Ghost is dedicated to the pair of gloves found there after the final session.

name: Unsigned Cuff
description: A wrist accessory with an unrecorded appointment in its past.
lore: The cuff was left on a clerk's desk beside an appointment card bearing a time but no date. 2020 Vision keeps the slot open in every new calendar.
